en.headline: Police smash multiple illegal fishing-machine dens in Sham Shui Po, arrest 25
en.dek: Officers from Sham Shui Po District raided units on several streets under Operation Rising Sun, seizing dozens of machines, gambling equipment and cash.
body: Police arrested 25 people after raiding multiple suspected illegal gambling dens equipped with fishing machines in Sham Shui Po on Wednesday afternoon.

Sham Shui Po District special duties officers mounted the operation, codenamed Rising Sun, and searched units on Nam Cheong Street, Apliu Street, Cheung Sha Wan Road and Keelung Street. They seized dozens of fishing-machine components, gambling paraphernalia and cash.

Those detained comprised 15 local men, six local women, two mainland men, one mainland woman and one foreign man, aged between 20 and 63. They are suspected of managing a gambling establishment and gambling in a gambling establishment. One 33-year-old local man was also held for failing to produce proof of identity. All are being detained for further inquiries.

Police reminded the public that under the Gambling Ordinance, managing a gambling establishment carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment, while gambling in such a place is punishable by a HK$50,000 fine and nine months’ jail.

zh.headline: 警深水埗搗破多個非法釣魚機賭場 拘25人
zh.dek: 深水埗警區人員展開代號「旭日」行動，搜查南昌街、鴨寮街、長沙灣道及基隆街多個單位，檢獲數十部釣魚機機件、賭具及賭款。
body: 警方昨日（26日）在深水埗搗破多個懷疑非法釣魚機賭場，拘捕25人。
深水埗警區特別職務隊人員經深入調查後，展開代號「旭日」的執法行動，於下午突擊搜查位於南昌街、鴨寮街、長沙灣道及基隆街多個單位，檢獲數十部釣魚機機件、一批賭具及賭款。
被捕人士包括15名本地男子、6名本地女子、2名內地男子、1名內地女子及1名外籍男子，年齡介乎20至63歲，分別涉嫌「管理賭博場所」及「在賭博場所內賭博」。其中一名33歲姓謝本地男子同時涉嫌「未能出示身份證明文件」。所有被捕人現正被扣留調查。
警方重申，根據《賭博條例》，管理賭博場所一經定罪最高可判罰款500萬元及監禁7年，在賭博場所內賭博最高可判罰款5萬元及監禁9個月。
